item.title: IHH Manages Insurance-Driven Delays As Patient Safety Events
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: MOH: Median Wait For Ward Bed From Emergency Department 144 Minutes
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad says patients admitted from emergency departments in government hospitals wait a median 144.4 minutes for a ward bed. Rising disease burden, specialist shortages, and patients shifting from private care are straining public hospitals. The post MOH: Median Wait For Ward Bed From Emergency Department 144 Minutes appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Experts Oppose Recruiting Foreign Housemen, Say 47% Shortage Not Critical
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Monash University’s Prof Arshil and MMA’s Dr Arasu don’t support hiring foreign housemen for public service, even though nearly half of HO slots are vacant. Arshil says MOs should be the focus, while Arasu says the shortage isn’t at a crisis level to justify importing HOs. The post Experts Oppose Recruiting Foreign Housemen, Say 47% Shortage Not Critical appeared first on CodeBlue .
